content: Patients diagnosed with atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD) or those identified as having a high risk for cardiovascular events, who also present with moderately elevated triglyceride levels, should consider incorporating icosapent ethyl into their treatment regimen. This therapy should be used as an adjunct to comprehensive lifestyle modifications, such as dietary changes and increased physical activity, as well as standard lipid-lowering medications. The addition of icosapent ethyl aims to provide further reduction in cardiovascular risk beyond what is achieved with lifestyle interventions and lipid-lowering therapies alone.
